literal: Let one guard as wealth self-control; gain than that greater is not to life.
translation: Guard self-control as a precious treasure. There is no greater wealth for a living being than that.
modern: அடக்கத்தை ஒரு சிறந்த செல்வமாகப் போற்றிக் காக்க வேண்டும். ஒருயிருக்கு அதைவிடச் சிறந்த செல்வம் வேறு எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the supreme value of self-control. It urges the reader to guard self-control as if it were the most precious material wealth. The word 'பொருள்' can mean meaning, reality, or wealth; here it specifically means wealth or treasure. Similarly, 'ஆக்கம்' can mean creation or prosperity, but here it means gain or wealth. The text states that for any living soul, there is no greater gain than mastering oneself, making self-control the ultimate treasure.
